name: codn-status
description: Tells codn what a Claude Code session knows of itself: its model and effort, how full its context is, how fast the model answered last, how much of the limits is used and when they reset, and in a few words what each of its agents is doing, such as the name of a file it reads or what it searches for. It writes that to the file codn names in CODN_STATUS, and nothing outside codn.
